# Bundesliga 2021-22 → 2025-26 row-level odds gap recovery — source assessment
id: req-20261001-005 | researched 2026-10-01 23:05 (Asia/Shanghai) — takeover from stale `processing` placeholder (last updated 14:52)

## 1. Verdict (per requested field group)

- **Pinnacle 1X2 (156 fields)**: football-data.co.uk D1 files provide pre-closing + closing Pinnacle 1X2 for all 5 seasons → all 156 fillable at documented pre-close+closing semantics. True opening: no free public bulk source found.
- **William Hill 1X2 (376 fields)**: D1 2021/22–2024/25 provide WH pre-close + WH closing → fillable for those 4 seasons. WH bookmaker is **entirely absent from the 2025/26 file** → the 2025/26 portion of this group has no football-data source (exact count needs a local inventory crosswalk; see unresolved_queue).
- **Pinnacle total-goals OU2.5 (199 fields)**: `P>2.5`/`P<2.5` + `PC>2.5`/`PC<2.5` present in all 5 season files → all 199 fillable pre-close+closing.
- **True opening (O_OPEN)**: unavailable from any free public bulk source for any requested group.
- **Qimen chart / nine-palace provenance**: no row-level evidence gathered (dedicated source search did not complete this pass) → marked unavailable, left for local manual review.

## 2. Primary source: football-data.co.uk (free, bulk, row-level)

URL pattern `https://www.football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/<SSSS>/D1.csv` (SSSS = 2122, 2223, 2324, 2425, 2526). Headers + sample rows fetched and verified 2026-10-01:

| Season file | WH pre-close (WHH/WHD/WHA) | WH closing (WHCH/WHCD/WHCA) | Pinnacle pre-close (PSH/PSD/PSA) | Pinnacle closing (PSCH/PSCD/PSCA) | Pinnacle OU pre-close (P>2.5/P<2.5) | Pinnacle OU closing (PC>2.5/PC<2.5) | Rows |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2122/D1.csv | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | 306 |
| 2223/D1.csv | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | (header only) |
| 2324/D1.csv | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | (header only) |
| 2425/D1.csv | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | 306 |
| 2526/D1.csv | **ABSENT** | **ABSENT** | yes | yes | yes | yes | 306 (season complete) |

Field semantics (official, verbatim from https://www.football-data.co.uk/notes.txt): base columns = **pre-closing** odds — "Betting odds for weekend games are collected Friday afternoons, and on Tuesday afternoons for midweek games." `C`-suffix columns = **closing** odds. A pre-close quote taken ~1–2 days before kickoff is NOT an opening price — do not label it O_OPEN.

Verified sample rows (row-level evidence):
- `2122/D1.csv`, 14/08/2021 **Augsburg–Hoffenheim**: PSH 3.2 / PSD 3.83 / PSA 2.23 → PSCH 3.29 / PSCD 3.66 / PSCA 2.25; WHH 3.2 / WHD 3.5 / WHA 2.15 → WHCH 3.2 / WHCD 3.6 / WHCA 2.15; P>2.5 1.64 / P<2.5 2.38 → PC>2.5 1.67 / PC<2.5 2.33
- `2425/D1.csv`, 24/08/2024 **Augsburg–Werder Bremen**: PSH 2.32 / PSD 3.55 / PSA 3.11 → PSCH 2.57 / PSCD 3.61 / PSCA 2.77; WHH 2.25 / WHD 3.5 / WHA 3.1 → WHCH 2.45 / WHCD 3.6 / WHCA 2.7; P>2.5 1.74 / P<2.5 2.18 → PC 1.71 / 2.26
- `2526/D1.csv`, 23/08/2025 **Frankfurt–Werder Bremen**: PSH 1.7 / PSD 4.26 / PSA 4.68 → PSCH 1.62 / PSCD 4.52 / PSCA 5.21; P>2.5 1.57 / P<2.5 2.5 → PC 1.52 / 2.63; no WH columns

Join key: (season, Date dd/mm/yy + Time kickoff, HomeTeam, AwayTeam). Normalization notes: the 2526 file lists the team as "Ein Frankfurt" vs "Eintracht Frankfurt" in earlier seasons — normalize before joining; Date format is dd/mm/yy.

## 3. O_OPEN / O_CLOSE / O_INTERVAL per recovered group

- Pinnacle 1X2 (156): O_CLOSE ✓ via PSCH/PSCD/PSCA; O_OPEN ✗ (no bulk source); O_INTERVAL: **pre-close→closing pair is strict-provenance SAFE** (documented collection rule); do not label as opening→closing.
- William Hill 1X2 (376): seasons 2021/22–2024/25: O_CLOSE ✓ via WHCH/WHCD/WHCA; 2025/26: ✗ from this source. O_OPEN ✗ bulk anywhere.
- Pinnacle OU2.5 (199): O_CLOSE ✓ via PC>2.5/PC<2.5; pre-close ✓; O_OPEN ✗ bulk.

## 4. Alternate sources for true opening (per-match only — no free bulk source)

1. **OddsPortal** (oddsportal.com): per-match pages with per-bookmaker opener + closer, incl. Pinnacle (independent forum evidence of fields like homeOpener/homeCloser). Caveat: "opening" = first quote the scraper captured, NO bookmaker-open timestamp — flag `opener_provenance: first_captured_by_oddsportal`. WH presence per match not verified this pass.
2. **live.nowscore.com/1x2/…**: per-match 初指/即时 incl. Pinna*(荷兰)=平博 row (pattern proven in this pipeline). Historical retention for 2021–2025 matches NOT verified this pass.
3. **500.com** historical European-index pages: per match 初赔/终赔; retention unverified.
4. **Ruled out**: schochastics/football-data repo (results-only dataset 1888–2023, no odds columns per its codebook); API-Football (fixtures/stats only — excluded per request); bookmaker affiliate "prediction" pages.
